ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is honored to offer this 2019 Lamborghini Urus for sale!

The Lamborghini Urus redefines what a luxury SUV can be, blending exotic Italian design with supercar-level performance and everyday usability. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 producing 641 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque, the Urus rockets from 0–60 mph in just 3.4 seconds while delivering a top speed of nearly 190 mph. Designed for the buyer who wants the practicality of an SUV without sacrificing exclusivity or performance, the Urus perfectly suits entrepreneurs, collectors, and enthusiasts who demand attention everywhere they go.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Lamborghini Urus yours today. All pricing and details provided are believed to be accurate, but we do not warrant or guarantee such accuracy.
